source: Conzerv Systems, EM 6400 DigitAN v03.02.01.00 Series Register Map, V03.02.02.00 consolidated register map (EM6400RegMap_V01.01.02.pdf)

sources.title: EM6400 series Modbus register map (EM6400RegMap_V01.01.02)
sources.note: PDF attached to the Schneider Electric India FAQ "Modbus Register address required for EM6400 meter"

notes: Addresses are the register numbers of the register map without the leading 4 (43901 is holding register 3901): Modicon numbering, 1-based, so the address on the wire is the register number minus 1.
The map has one table for all models; the description of a register says when it exists only on some of them (EM6400 Basic, IE, DM, DM+IE, THD and their combinations, EM6434, EM6459, EM6436).

Values are 32-bit floats or 32-bit integers (the run-second counters and the maximum demand time), no scaling needed. The register map does not state the order of the two registers; this map uses the least significant register first, which is what third-party integration guides report for the EM6400 series. If the values look wrong, try big word order.
The register map's reserved registers and its 'old' energy registers (a second set of 43122, 43124 and so on, one register after the main energy registers) are left out.
